How's it going? W: 嗨，保罗。最近怎么样？ 2 M: Hi, Suzanne. Just keeping busy with the usual stuff, filling prescriptions, talking to patients about their medications, that kind of thing. How about you? M: 嗨，苏珊。就是忙着做平常的事，开处方药、和患者聊聊他们的用药情况之类的。你呢？ 3 W: Same here, although I did have an interesting case come in this morning. A patient came in, inquiring about a medication that had a potential interaction with another medication she was already taking. W: 我也一样，不过今天早上来了一个挺有意思的病例。一位患者来咨询一种药，而这种药可能会和她已 经在服用的另一种药产生相互作用。 Questions 5 to 8 are based on the conversation you have just heard. 4 M: Oh, that's always tricky. What did you do? M: 哦，这种情况总是很棘手。你怎么处理的？ 5 W: I explained the issue to her as best I could, and recommended she double-check with her doctor. And you know what? She actually followed my advice, and the doctor ended up switching the patient's medication. W: 我尽可能向她解释了这个问题，并建议她再向医生确认一下。你猜怎么着？她真的听从了我的建议， 最后医生给这位患者换了药。 6 M: Ah, that's great. You must feel quite accomplished. M: 啊，那太好了。你一定很有成就感。 7 W: Totally. These moments are the highlights of my routine work, employing my pharmaceutical expertise to the benefit of people's health and well-being. W: 完全是。这些时刻是我日常工作中最精彩的部分，运用我的药学专业知识来促进人们的健康和福祉。 8 M: I fully agree. Unfortunately, the opposite is true when the patient is too stubborn and they refuse to listen to us. M: 我完全同意。遗憾的是，当患者太固执、不肯听我们的话时，情况就正好相反。 9 W: So true. In other developments, we've had a lot of people coming in to get their flu shots, which is always good to see. W: 确实如此。另外，最近有很多人来接种流感疫苗，这总是件令人高兴的事。 10 M: Good, good. I've been working on a new medication therapy management program for our patients with chronic conditions. It helps patients manage their medications more effectively. M: 很好，很好。我一直在为患有慢性疾病的患者制定一个新的药物治疗管理项目，帮助患者更有效地管 理他们的用药。 11 W: That sounds interesting. W: 听起来很有意思。 12 M: We review all of their medications, and make sure that they're taking them as prescribed. We also look for any potential drug interactions or side effects. Patient response has so far been very positive. Some have reported seeing improvements in their health, which is really rewarding to see. M: 我们会检查他们所有的药物，确保他们按照处方服用。我们还会查找任何潜在的药物相互作用或副 作用。到目前为止，患者的反响非常积极。有些人说自己的健康状况有所改善，看到这一点真的很令人 欣慰。 13 W: That's great to hear. Do you use text message reminders? W: 听到这个真好。你们会使用短信提醒吗？ 14 M: Yes, absolutely. M: 是的，当然会。 15 W: It's a great idea. Medication non-adherence is a big problem, especially for older patients. W: 这是个很好的主意。用药依从性差是个大问题，尤其是对老年患者来说。 16 M: We're still in the early stages of the program, but I'm hopeful that it will make a real difference for our patients. M: 这个项目还处于早期阶段，但我希望它能真正改善我们患者的情况。

B) 未提及 录音中没有提到患者或公众对 pharmaceutical experts 的不信任，选项属于无中生有。 D) 答非所问 录音提到 text message reminders 是为了解决 medication non-adherence，Need for constant reminding 把提醒需求当作大问题，但女士明确说的大问题是 Medication non- adherence。 借用原文：Do you use text message reminders? Section B 1 In America, at least, passion is a word that often comes up on job descriptions and in interviews. On the whole, passionate people are thought of in a positive light and considered likely to achieve their goals. But when it comes to predicting achievement, has the importance of passion been overstated? 至少在美国，求职描述和面试中经常会提到“热情”一词。总的来说，人们对有热情的人持正面看法，认为 他们很可能实现自己的目标。但说到预测成就时，热情的重要性是否被夸大了？ 2 According to a new study from Stanford University, passion may be less important in certain cultures, and the fact that passion is often seen as a key to achievement may reflect a distinctly Western model of motivation. The chief factor explored in the study was how individualistic a society was. In individualistic cultures, the researchers assert, people are more motivated by pursuing paths related to their passions, but those in collectivistic cultures are more likely to see themselves as part of a network. They often place fulfilling obligations to others above focusing on their own interests. 根据斯坦福大学的一项新研究，热情在某些文化中的重要性可能较低，而热情常被视为成就关键这一事 实，或许反映了一种明显具有西方特色的动机模式。研究考察的主要因素是一个社会的个人主义程度。研 究人员断言，在个人主义文化中，人们更容易受到追求与自身热情相关道路的激励；而集体主义文化中的 人则更可能将自己视为某个社会网络的一部分。他们往往更重视履行对他人的义务，而不是专注于自身的 兴趣。 Questions 9 to 11 are based on the passage you have just heard. 3 The researchers looked at data from nearly 60 countries. They found that in science subjects, passion was positively correlated with academic achievements. Higher levels of enjoyment and interest also bolstered test scores. 研究人员考察了来自近60个国家的数据。他们发现，在科学类学科中，热情与学业成就呈正相关。更高程 度的愉悦感和兴趣也会提高测试成绩。 4 But the strength of this correlation wasn't the same across cultures. analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: The problem is, even if we are committed to working hard on our goals, our natural tendency is to return to our old habits at some point. Making a permanent lifestyle change is really difficult. 问题是，即使我们致力于努力实现目标，我们的自然倾向还是在某个时刻回到旧习惯。永久 改变生活方式真的很难。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is required of you when you begin practising a new habit?
questions.stemZh: 说话者认为，当你开始培养一种新习惯时，对你有什么要求？
questions.answerText: A lot of conscious effort to remember to do it.

analysis.label: 定位
analysis.text: Another science-based reason to focus on one thing at a time is that when you begin practising a new habit, it requires a lot of conscious effort to remember to do it. 另一个一次只专注一件事的科学依据是，当你开始练习一个新习惯时，你需要付出大量有意 识的努力去记住去做这件事。

analysis.label: 信号
analysis.text: 时间状语 + 需求动词。题干中的 when you begin practising a new habit 在 when you begin practising a new habit 中原样复现，紧随其后的 requires a lot of conscious effort to remember to do it 就是答案所在。

analysis.label: 替换
analysis.text: requires a lot of conscious effort to remember to do it ↔ A lot of conscious effort to remember to do it 名词短语截取

analysis.label: 排除
analysis.text: A) 与原文相反 The ability to make the process automatic 来自 the process is more or less mindless and automatic，但那是 after a while / eventually 之后的阶段，不是 begin 阶段；题干 问的是刚开始，因此相反。 借用原文：the process is more or less mindless and automatic B) 张冠李戴 A practical timetable for implementation 把 when, where, and how you intend to implement a particular behavior 里的具体计划要素（when/where/how）包装成 timetable，但这是关于 implementation intentions 的研究，不是开始养成新 habit 时的 普遍要求。 借用原文：when, where, and how you intend to implement a particular behavior D) 未提及 Concentration on the benefits it will provide 中 benefits 一词在录音中未被提及，属于 用常识编造的干扰项。 1 It was a lazy, hazy, crazy day on the dwarf planet Pluto when New Horizons, a spacecraft from Earth, flew by at a speed of 31,000 mph (miles per hour) two years ago. The spacecraft took a bunch of photos, made some quick measurements of Pluto's atmosphere, and sent them all back here, giving planetary scientists their first up-close look of the distant dwarf planet. 两年前，在新视野号这艘来自地球的航天器以每小时31,000英里（英里/小时）的速度飞掠而过时，矮行 星冥王星度过了慵懒、朦胧而疯狂的一天。这艘航天器拍摄了大量照片，对冥王星的大气层进行了一些快 速测量，并将这些数据全部传回地球，使行星科学家们首次近距离观察到这颗遥远的矮行星。 Questions 19 to 21 are based on the recording you have just heard. 2 One of the more bizarre things they found was that the haze in Pluto's atmosphere was much thicker than previously thought. The planet also had an atmosphere much cooler than earlier estimates, topping out at −333.4°F. 他们发现的较为奇异的现象之一，是冥王星大气层中的霾比先前认为的厚得多。这颗行星的大气层也比早 先估计的冷得多，最高温度仅为−333.4°F。 3 Now, a study published in Nature links those two atmospheric observations. A computer model developed by planetary scientist Xi Zhang and colleagues shows the haze of tiny droplets in the upper atmosphere is likely scattering light from the Sun, preventing heat from reaching the planet below. We see hazy skies on Earth too, from time to time, whenever solid particles get suspended in the air—from water-based fogs, to ash from fires, to the toxic droplets that make up a thick smog. But on Earth, the overall temperature of the planet is dominated by the distribution of gases in our atmosphere. 如今，《自然》杂志发表的一项研究将这两项大气观测结果联系了起来。行星科学家张希及其同事开发的 一种计算机模型显示，高层大气中由微小液滴形成的霾很可能会散射来自太阳的光，阻止热量抵达下方的 行星。地球上也会不时出现雾霾天气，每当固体颗粒悬浮在空气中时，就可能形成这种现象，从含水雾气 到火灾产生的灰烬，再到构成浓重烟雾的有毒液滴，都是如此。但在地球上，行星的整体温度主要由大气 层中气体的分布决定。 4 On Pluto, the authors suggest, haze might be more influential. Particles can reflect light from the Sun here on Earth: It happens after volcanoes erupt, emitting clouds of particles that reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere. Some people even propose imitating this phenomenon to alleviate the effects of climate change. But our planet isn't dominated by that process, or at least it hasn't been for a few billion years. 作者认为，在冥王星上，霾的影响可能更大。在地球上，颗粒物能够反射来自太阳的光：火山喷发后会释 放出由颗粒物组成的云团，将太阳光线反射回大气层。有些人甚至提出模仿这一现象，以减轻气候变化的 影响。但我们的行星并不是由这一过程主导的，至少在过去几十亿年里不是如此。 5 If Pluto's atmosphere is very different from ours and from that of other nearby planets, it could help scientists expand their understanding of planetary atmospheres. But right now, this is just a good guess based on data from New Horizons and a sophisticated computer model, not direct observations of the haze's composition. 如果冥王星的大气层与地球以及其他邻近行星的大气层截然不同，这将有助于科学家拓展对行星大气层的 认识。但目前，这只是基于新视野号获得的数据和一个复杂计算机模型提出的合理推测，而不是对霾的成 分进行直接观测所得出的结论。 6 There are other theories floating around to explain Pluto's cool temperatures, including blaming the cold air on gases in the atmosphere. 关于解释冥王星低温的理论还有其他一些，包括把寒冷的空气归因于大气层中的气体。 7 Luckily, the authors will get a chance to test their notions when the James Webb Space Telescope launches later. That observatory can detect different spectrums of light, which the hazy Plutonian atmosphere would be positively glowing with as it scattered sunlight. The researchers just have to wait and see if the light from the telescope validates their bright idea. 幸运的是，詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜稍后发射后，作者们将有机会检验他们的观点。这座天文台能够探测不 同光谱的光，而冥王星朦胧的大气层在散射阳光时很可能会发出大量这样的光。研究人员只需等待并观察 望远镜接收到的光是否会验证他们的这个妙想。

analysis.text: A) 原词陷阱 A 项的 solid particles in the air 直接来自 solid particles get suspended in the air，但 原文说的是地球‘雾/霾天’的成因，并非决定地球整体温度的因素，属于盗用原词答非所问。 借用原文：solid particles get suspended in the air C) 原词陷阱 C 项的 clouds of particles reflecting sun rays 来自 emitting clouds of particles that reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere，但那是火山喷发后的局部现象，不是决定地 球整体温度的主因。 借用原文：clouds of particles that reflect the Sun's rays into the atmosphere D) 与原文相反 D 项说 climate change 的加剧效应决定温度，而原文 alleviate the effects of climate change 讲的是‘缓解’气候变化，并非‘加剧’；选项把 alleviating 偷换成 aggravated，极性 相反。 借用原文：alleviate the effects of climate change

analysis.text: A) behavioural 主题词眼熟乱选 本卷最阴的干扰：全文确实讲行为因素，behavioural cause 看似点题——但破折号引出的解释 强调的是"此前未被点破的深层原因"，重在"潜藏"而非"行为的"；且 28 空 the ___ biases 只能 由 behavioural 填（behavioural biases 是行为金融学术语），在此提前用掉它，28 空将无词 可填。 C) fragile 脆弱的原因搭配不通 fragile 修饰 cause 语义不通——"脆弱的原因"既非惯用搭配，也与破折号后的操纵行为无关。 G) overlapping 重叠的原因无中生有 文中只讲"另一个"原因，没有任何"多个原因重叠"的信息，overlapping 属无中生有。

In Matamorisca, they intervened in 17 barren hectares owned by the regional government and peppered them with their signature device: a biodegradable(可生物降解的) cardboard container they call the cocoon which can hold 25 litres of water underground to aid a seedling's first year. Around 16,000 trees, including oaks, ashes, walnuts, rowans, and whitebeams, were planted in May 2018, and the company reports that 96% of them survived that year's burning hot summer without extra irrigation, a critical milestone for a young tree.

blocks.label: C
blocks.text: "Does nature return by itself?" asks Arnout Asjes, Land Life Company's chief technology officer, who oversees a mix of drone(无人机) and satellite imagery, big data analysis, soil enhancement, QR(二维 码) tagging and site-specific tree configuration designs. "Probably, but it can take decades or hundreds of years, so we are speeding things up."

blocks.label: D
blocks.text: His company belongs to a global movement of organisations trying to save degraded or deforested areas, ranging from fertile tropical lowlands to dry hills in temperate(温带的) regions. Spurred by global biodiversity loss and climate change, these groups are pushing the boundary of how to revive forest cover. "It's not a theoretical proposition," says Walter Vergara, a forest and climate specialist at the World Resources Institute(WRI). "It requires the right incentives, the right stakeholders, the right analysis and sufficient capital, but it can happen."

blocks.label: E
blocks.text: How these factors come together for a particular project—and whether saving destroyed woods is even possible—depends on what kind of ecosystem you have in mind. Secondary forests in the Amazon are different from Texas pines recovering after wildfires or the Arctic timber woods that cover much of Sweden. Each provides different reasons for reforestation programs and each has particular needs. In the dry conditions around Matamorisca and similar areas in Spain, Land Life Company worries about rapid desertification(沙漠化). As its focus is on restoring an ecosystem, it works with organisations that don't expect their money back.

blocks.label: F
blocks.text: With around 600 hectares replanted around the world since 2015 and another 1,100 planned for this year, the company's drive fits into the Bonn Challenge, a global effort to restore 150 million hectares of the world's deforested and degraded land by 2020. That's an area roughly the size of Iran or Mongolia. By 2030, the goal is to reach 350 million hectares—20% more land than India. These targets include both the rehabilitation of forested areas that have lost density or look a bit weak (a process known as 'restoration' in forestry jargon) and the recovery of forest cover in areas where it was completely cleared (what's known as 'reforestation').

blocks.label: G
blocks.text: That global target is broken into smaller pieces and takes shape in Latin America as the 20x20 Initiative, an effort to contribute 20 million hectares to the overall goal by initiating small to medium projects with the political backing of governments. Unlike Land Life Company, this region-wide project makes the economic and business case for reforestation, even though they are after biodiversity conservation. "You need to bring in private sector money," says WRI's Vergara, who leads the initiative, "and that capital needs to see a return on their investment." A study he led predicts Latin America would see an estimated net present value of about $23bn over a 50-year period if it reaches its goal.

blocks.label: H
blocks.text: Money can come from timber sales in sustainably managed forests or from harvesting 'non-wood products' like nuts, oils and fruits from the trees. You can take note of how much carbon dioxide your forest is capturing and sell carbon credits to companies keen to offset their emissions. Or you can even grow the forest hoping that biodiversity will attract ecotourists who'd pay for lodging, birdwatching tours and meals.

blocks.label: I
blocks.text: Still, these backers are not your high-street bank. Money for the 20x20 Initiative comes mostly from financial organisations with triple goal—a modest return on their investment, environmental benefits and social gains—known as impact investors. Coffee grows naturally in such forests, so copying that in farms is taking the crop back to its roots. P1 Smartphones have always posed challenges for parents of teens. From social media apps to excessive screen time, the digital world is as threatening as the physical.

P2 A new study shows that about half of parents of teens are worried about their teens being exposed to explicit content online. This is a valid concern, of course. But there are ways to alleviate the spread of explicit content, from changing the settings in their kids' phone to monitoring such content with apps like Bark.

P3 Just as alarming, if not more so, is that the amount of time teens spend on social media can lead to anxiety and depression.

P4 Excessive screen time has detrimental effects, for a lot of obvious reasons. Constant media consumption inhibits healthy activities associated with childhood, like spending time outside, exercising, talking to friends and family. If it interferes with sleep, that's even worse.

P5 Ample research shows too much smartphone use produces significant anxiety, depression, and feelings of isolation in teens. Teens log on to social media or spend time online trying to make connections, but end up feeling more alone and sad than ever. Faceless communication not only produces feelings of isolation and loneliness but increases instances of online bullying and susceptibility to criminal conducts.

P6 Though I've banned most social media, I've still battled smartphone time with my own kids. A lot of the time I wish I could throw my kids' smartphones into the nearest lake. The convenience of communication—when they need a ride home from school after practice, for instance—often feels like it isn't worth the battle to keep their screen time low and productive, and continue to encourage "real-life" activities outside and with friends and family. I understand the addiction and often tell them I'm not sure how I would have handled having a smartphone as a teen. As an adult, I too, struggle with overuse.

P7 In a recent TV interview to promote a new film about a mother and daughter navigating social media use, actress Kate Winslet expressed her view on teens and social media—and her concern mirrors the trends. "I do definitely feel that the world of social media is frightening to parents because we don't really know what's there," she said. "We don't know how our children are using it. We don't know the effects that it's really having on them."

P8 I don't think the U.S. government should regulate social media and teen smartphone use, but it is a vital topic for parents to understand and take seriously. Unfortunately, now, parents don't just have to worry about real-world dangers, but all the ones sneaking online and the effects they have on teenagers and their mental health.

reading-2.raw:
P1 What does self-discipline look like at work? Sometimes, it's the ability to resist temptation, such as distractions to avoid a particular task. Other times it's the ability to persist with a task when your energy and motivation seem low.

P2 What do you believe about the nature of your own self-discipline? Is it something that runs on internal energy that is spent with use? Or is it something that is bolstered as you apply it and persist?

P3 Your answer matters, as it determines how much self-discipline you experience. For years, research in psychology pointed to self-control as a resource that is depleted with use and needs to be restored through breaks, rest, or sleep. More recently, however, research points to the importance of mindset. If you view self-discipline as an expendable resource, your willpower tends to fade with use. If you believe that exercising your self-control strengthens and fuels it, that is more likely to be your experience as you resist temptation or push yourself to get something done that is not appealing. 

P4 If you don't already view self-discipline as a force that feeds itself, what might you do? Reflect on times that you had initial difficulty resisting temptation, getting started on something, or sticking with it, but pushed ahead and accomplished the task or met the goal. That's the kind of experience we're talking about with this particular belief about self-discipline, and you've already had such an experience, so you've shown that it's possible. When you feel your willpower and motivation fading, remind yourself of those previous experiences and imagine the same happening now.

P5 What if your experiences have always seemed to indicate that your self-control diminishes with use, and you need breaks to recharge? There's nothing wrong with that as long as you can afford to take those breaks. If not, remind yourself that not everyone experiences self-discipline as a depletable resource and that your experience might be different if you focus on gathering more energy at this point rather than focusing on how difficult it is to continue or the need for a break.

P6 Also, if you know someone who is a role model of self-discipline, picture that person in your situation, persisting in the task. Regardless of how you do it, as you push forward to continue to accomplish progress, be sure to mentally reinforce yourself by taking pride in your ability to exert more willpower as you persist.

P7 The benefits of exerting willpower are cumulative. Your self-discipline is akin to a muscle, and each time you resist temptation or persist in a task despite a lack of motivation, you strengthen that muscle, leading to less effort and resistance in similar instances in the future.

writing.directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words. You should copy the sentence given in quotes at the beginning of your essay.
writing.model: In an era of rapid social development, it is vitally important to enhance young people's sense of responsibility. As society changes at an unprecedented pace, young people often face distractions and pressures that weaken their commitment to family, community, and the future. Without a strong sense of responsibility, they may become self-centered and short-sighted. The decline of responsibility among youth is partly caused by the instant gratification culture brought by technology and social media. Many young people are used to receiving immediate rewards and may avoid duties that require long-term effort. To address this problem, schools and families should work together to cultivate accountability through real tasks and role models. For example, involving students in community service can help them understand the value of contributing to society. In conclusion, enhancing young people's sense of responsibility is not only a personal virtue but also a social necessity. Only when the younger generation takes responsibility seriously can society achieve sustainable development and harmony.

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 发展正在改变面貌（主语策略：原句主语） 中文核心动词是改变，做这动作的是电子商务的蓬勃发展，承受对象是「中国农村的面貌」。英文 主干立为 The development is changing the face：主语 The booming development of e- commerce，谓语 is changing（进行时呼应「正在」），宾语 the face of rural China。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 两个「的」字修饰后置 主干之外的修饰全是「的」字结构：电子商务的作「发展」的定语 后置介词短语 of e- commerce；「中国农村的」作「面貌」的定语 后置 of rural China；「蓬勃」「深刻」分别译 作形容词 booming 与副词 profoundly，直接贴在被修饰词旁。全句无需从句，把定语从名词前 搬到名词后即可。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 「正在改变」用现在进行时 is changing——它属于全篇「现在」时间域，与基调一致，是基允许 内的偏离，不要写成一般现在时 changes（丢了「正在」的进行义）。 单复数与冠词 development 表抽象「发展」不可数，用单数不加复数；face 此处特指中国农村的面貌，用 the face。rural China 是固定表达，China 前不加 the。 主谓一致 主语中心词是 development（单数），谓语用 is changing，不要被紧随其后的 of e-commerce 带偏。

sentences.text: 「使……」降级为定语从句 使城市消费者能够与卖家实时互动降级为 which 引导的非限定定语从句 which enables urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time，插回主语之后；「促进农村发展的」修饰 way 后置不定式 to promote rural development；近年来 句首时间状语 In recent years。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 近年来＋「已成为」是现在完成时的双重标志，谓语用 has become；这是对基调的合理偏离，不 能用一般现在时 becomes（丢了「至今已成」的完成义）。 主谓一致 主语 live-streaming commerce 是单数概念，谓语用 has become；定语从句内 which 指代它， 从句谓语用 enables。 搭配 「与某人实时互动」interact with sb. in real time，in real time 是固定搭配无冠词；「一种新方 式」a new way to do sth.，way 后接不定式。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: In recent years, live-streaming commerce, which enables urban consumers to interact with sellers in real time, has become a new way to promote rural development. 4. 电子商务打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒，拓宽了农产品销售渠道，帮助农村居民增收致富。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 电商打破壁垒、拓宽渠道（主语策略：原句主语） 主语电子商务带三个动作：打破、拓宽、帮助。前两个「打破了城乡之间的信息壁垒」「拓宽了农 产品销售渠道」是并列的核心成果，可作共用同一主语的并列谓语 has broken down ... and expanded ...；「帮助……」是这两个成果带来的结果，留给下一步降级。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 结果动作降为分词 帮助农村居民增收致富是前两动作带来的结果 现在分词短语 helping rural residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity 作结果状语；「城乡之间的」修饰壁垒→between urban and rural areas 后置；「农产品销售渠道」→sales channels for agricultural products， 渠道用 for 短语后置修饰。四字格「增收致富」拆开意译为 increase their incomes and achieve prosperity。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 两个「了」均表已完成且影响延续至今，用现在完成时 has broken down ... and expanded ...， 共用一个 has；分词 helping 无时态问题。 单复数 barriers 与 channels 均为泛指复数；incomes 指众居民各自的收入，用复数。 搭配 「打破壁垒」break down the barriers 为惯用搭配；「城乡之间」between urban and rural areas；「增收」increase one's incomes，one's 与 rural residents 对应为 their。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: E-commerce has broken down the information barriers between urban and rural areas and expanded sales channels for agricultural products, helping rural residents increase their incomes and achieve prosperity. 5. 数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合，正在为中国农村发展注入前所未有的活力。

sentences.label: 主干
sentences.text: 融合正在注入活力（主语策略：原句主语） 核心动词注入→is injecting；发出动作的主语是「数字经济与乡村振兴的深度融合」这个整体名词 短语→The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization；宾语「活力」 →vitality；「为中国农村发展」表受益方向→into China's rural development。主干：The deep integration is injecting vitality into China's rural development。

sentences.label: 降级
sentences.text: 本就是单主干句，修饰后置即可 本句中文本身只有一个谓语「注入」，无需降级从句：「数字经济与乡村振兴的」 后置 of the digital economy with rural revitalization；「深度」 形容词 deep 前置修饰 integration； 「前所未有的」→unprecedented 前置修饰 vitality；「为中国农村发展」 介词短语 into China's rural development 表注入方向。

sentences.label: 语法
sentences.text: 时态 「正在注入」用现在进行时 is injecting，与句1「正在改变」首尾呼应，同属全篇「现在」域。 单复数 integration、vitality 均为抽象不可数名词，用单数、不加复数；主语中心词 integration 是单 数，谓语用 is。 搭配 「为……注入活力」inject vitality into ... 为固定搭配，into 不可换成 to；「A与B的融合」the integration of A with B。

sentences.label: 译文
sentences.text: The deep integration of the digital economy with rural revitalization is injecting unprecedented vitality into China's rural development. 英语六级 2026年6月·第2套 · 全卷构成 Part III Part III Part III Part III
